description: The state's oldest and largest pro-life organization has endorsed Representative Kelly Keisling for TN House District 38, representing Clay, Macon, Pickett, Scott and part of Fentress Counties. Citing Keisling’s demonstrated commitment to defending Tennessee's vulnerable unborn children and their mothers, the organization underscored their support. “Representative Keisling represents Tennessee's pro-life values and will be a consistent voice for those who can't speak for themselves," said Roger
paid_for_by: Paid for by Kelly Keisling for State Representative, John Keisling, Treasurer
title: Tennessee Right to Life PAC Endorses Representative Kelly Keisling for State House Based on Record of Shared Commitment and Dedication to Pro-Life Cause
